choice.description: Rate incident impact using only reported facts. Use the highest fully supported level. Rubric — 0: No function impaired; cosmetic only; 1: One user or a nonessential function impaired, with a workaround; 2: Many users blocked from a core function, no data loss; 3: Confirmed irreversible data loss or physical harm.

contexts: All features work normally; only an icon looks off.
